name: react-native-best-practices
headline: MCP-Go: Integrate LLMs with External Data Sources
short_description: MCP-Go is a powerful Go implementation of the Model Context Protocol, facilitating integration between LLM applications and various external data sources and tools. This enables enhanced data-driven decision-making and automation for developers and businesses alike.
author: mark3labs

sections.overview:
MCP-Go provides a robust Go-based implementation of the Model Context Protocol, designed to integrate LLM applications with external data sources and tools. It enables developers to build AI-driven applications that can access and process data from various systems, facilitating enhanced decision-making and automation workflows. The project includes OpenTelemetry tracing support for monitoring and observability, with optional integration available through a separate module to keep core dependencies minimal. MCP-Go's architecture supports both server and client implementations, allowing flexible deployment patterns for LLM-powered applications that need real-time access to external information and services.
Integrating LLMs with CRM systems to provide real-time customer insights and analytics.
Automating the retrieval of data from external APIs, enabling LLM applications to access and utilize up-to-date information.
Building custom workflows that combine LLM capabilities with various data sources to automate complex business processes.
Enhancing reporting tools by integrating LLMs for natural language generation based on data from databases.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install mark3labs/mcp-go`
`git clone https://github.com/mark3labs/mcp-go`
sections.usage:
```
Integrate [DATA_SOURCE] with our LLM application using MCP-Go. The data source should be connected to Mode for real-time analytics. Ensure the integration supports [SPECIFIC_DATA_TYPES] and provides [REQUIRED_FUNCTIONALITIES]. Document the steps and any potential challenges encountered during the integration process.
```
Copy

```
The integration of [DATA_SOURCE] with our LLM application using MCP-Go was successfully completed. The data source is now connected to Mode, enabling real-time analytics. The integration supports JSON, CSV, and XML data types and provides functionalities such as data filtering, aggregation, and visualization. During the integration process, we encountered a challenge with data type conversion, which was resolved by implementing custom data type handlers. The integration has significantly enhanced our data-driven decision-making capabilities.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
